title: AdaThinking-E: One-Token Entropy Regulation for Adaptive Thinking
abstract: arXiv:2608.26141v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal large language models have demonstrated strong document reasoning capabilities by incorporating explicit thinking processes. While this capability significantly improves performance on challenging tasks, current models apply such deep reasoning uniformly to all questions, resulting in unnecessary computational overhead for simple task. This not only degrades user experience but also negatively impact accuracy on benchmark datasets. We identify the critical need for adaptive thinking mechanisms that can intelligently determine when to engage reasoning based on question complexity. To address this, we propose AdaThinking-E, a novel reinforcement learning framework that learns adaptive thinking through one-token entropy regulation. Our key insight is that model confidence in the decision to engage thinking (or not) can be quantified through entropy analysis of the predicted probability distribution at critical decision tokens. translated_title: AdaThinking-E：基于单令牌熵调控的自适应思考机制
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型通过引入显式思考过程，展现出了强大的文档推理能力。尽管这种能力显著提升了在挑战性任务上的表现，但当前模型对所有问题均统一应用深度推理，导致在简单任务上产生不必要的计算开销。这不仅降低了用户体验，还对基准数据集的准确性产生了负面影响。我们识别出对自适应思考机制的关键需求，该机制能根据问题复杂度智能判断何时启动推理。为解决这一问题，我们提出了AdaThinking-E，一种新颖的强化学习框架，通过单令牌熵调控学习自适应思考。我们的核心见解是，模型在决定是否启动思考（或不启动）时的置信度，可以通过对关键决策令牌处预测概率分布的熵分析来量化。
tldr: 本文提出AdaThinking-E，一种通过单令牌熵调控的自适应思考强化学习框架，能根据问题复杂度智能决定是否启用深度推理，从而减少简单任务的计算开销并提升整体准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AdaThinking-E, a reinforcement learning framework with one-token entropy regulation that adaptively decides whether to engage deep reasoning based on question complexity, reducing computational overhead on simple tasks while improving overall accuracy.
